description: Conformance vectors for offer-identity-ref-v1 (docs/spec/offer-identity-ref.md). offer_identity_ref = SHA-256(JCS(x402_response)), where x402_response is the exact x402Response object (x402Version + accepts[] of PaymentRequirements) served at S1. A verifier recomputes the hash from an independently held copy of the advertised offer and compares it against the reference a later artifact cites — any divergence, whether from tampering or from a Seller substituting a different offer after the fact (T1), surfaces as the same recompute mismatch.
comparator_rule: PASS requires SHA-256(JCS(x402_response)) == declared offer_identity_ref, byte-exact. Any difference in accepts[] (amount, payee, asset, resource, or any other PaymentRequirements field) produces a different hash by construction — there is no separate 'was this offer substituted' check beyond the recompute comparison.

vectors.description: Baseline: single-mechanism offer (one PaymentRequirements entry in accepts). Verifier holds an independent copy of the exact x402Response served and recomputes the same hash.

accepts.description: Current weather data for a given location

vectors.description: v1 invariant 1: offer advertises two accepted mechanisms (exact/base-sepolia and exact/eth-sepolia) for the same resource. offer_identity_ref commits to the complete accepts array, not to whichever single entry a Buyer later selects at S3.

T1 CRITICAL negative: a later artifact cites offer_identity_ref for the CHEAP offer (maxAmountRequired=10000), but the x402_response the verifier independently holds — the one actually served at S1 — is the EXPENSIVE offer for the same resource (maxAmountRequired=50000, otherwise identical). This is the exact shape of offer substitution the RFP names for T1: a Seller pairing a cheap-offer transaction with the expensive offer after the fact. The recompute mismatch catches it directly, with no separate substitution-detection step.
vectors.failure_detail: declared offer_identity_ref resolves to a different (cheaper) offer than the x402_response actually held by the verifier

vectors.description: Generic negative: declared offer_identity_ref is a zero digest, unrelated to any real offer. Same check path as the substitution vector — this profile does not distinguish 'corrupted reference' from 'substituted offer' at the invariant level, both are a recompute mismatch.
vectors.failure_detail: declared offer_identity_ref does not match SHA-256(JCS(x402_response))
